'''Morro Spaceport''' was one of the busiest [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] in the [[Bright Jewel sector/Legends|Bright Jewel sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. Located at the terminus of the Path of Coins, the spaceport was the central feature of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. It was named after a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] colonist named [[Morro (Corellian)|Morro]] when the planet was first settled by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="MPQ" />
